headers.comment: HTML must always revalidate. The app's CSS is inline in src/index.html and the cache-version chain (?v=N) only busts main.js and the modules — so a cached HTML gives a visitor new JS with old CSS. That is how a fixed full-screen overlay bug kept reappearing for returning visitors. Keep this.
Same for the JSON the app loads; those are versioned by `const V` in main.js loadData(), but a stale copy is never worth serving.
